evidence.title: Procergs July 2026 physical report records ongoing construction of its new substation
evidence.excerpt: The official July physical report identifies item I.b as construction of the new substation, states work has begun and remains ongoing in July, and binds it to AGTech contract 6033-00. Existing recovery items marked complete are separate.

metadata.source_authority_basis: Owner and state technology company publishes its own project-specific physical-progress report; not an aggregate investment or forecast inference.
metadata.status_as_of_normalization: Conservative month-start representation of the explicit July 2026 status, following the existing Chesterfield and San Bovio convention. This is not an asserted observation day or construction-start day. The whole source month lies within May 22–August 20.
metadata.publication_date_semantics: Exact public release day is unknown. The report heading says 30/07/2026; PDF file metadata and August hosting path are not the physical observation date.
metadata.physical_scope: Only new civil/electrical substation infrastructure at the existing Porto Alegre datacenter campus is selected. Existing halls may operate concurrently; they are not newly built halls and do not supply the project lifecycle.
metadata.source_template_caveats: Page 3 red comparison heading repeats July and page 5 footer refers to July-to-August variation. Preserve these template inconsistencies; selected item I.b itself expressly says July. Page 6 contracted/spent percentages are financial, not physical completion.
metadata.excluded_scopes: Earlier engineering delivery, completed basement/fire/recovery works, remote disaster recovery, purchased storage and software, undelivered generator equipment, and cooling removed from this funding scope are not selected as separate projects or campuses.
metadata.successor_review: The captured August 17 original interview describes the existing datacenter as rebuilt but places completion of the whole renewed electrical structure in September. It does not establish completion of this selected new substation by August 20. A bounded named completed/cancelled query found no contrary authoritative event; absence is not proven.
